title: talking-avatar camera track v1 (draft)
description: One camera track for one moment id, including ~variant ids. See docs/camera-track-contract.md. Status: draft, not locked.

x.description: Crop center x as a fraction of the still width (anchor.json convention).

y.description: Crop center y as a fraction of the still height.

w.description: Crop width as a fraction of the still width. Must keep the crop inside the still.

h.description: Crop height as a fraction of the still height. Must keep the crop inside the still.

start.description: Seconds. Clock is open question 4 in the contract.

end.description: Seconds, >= start. Cues must not overlap.

ease.description: Interpolation from `from` to `to`. Allowed values are open question 5. Omit when from equals to (a hold).

id.description: Moment id, including ~variant segments. Unique. Equals the sidecar file stem when the track is a file.

still.description: Path to the shipped still, relative to the stills root. No absolute paths. Naming this still is how a moment overrides the scene default.

standeeOff.description: When true, character standees are off for this moment. Default false. Used by .lid-choice and .08.

opening.description: Start on the full-width shot with letterbox bars, hold, then push in. Hold length is open question 6.

cues.description: Ordered camera moves. Empty means a static still; standeeOff and opening still apply.

tracks.description: Reading-aid catalog. Sidecar vs catalog is open question 2.
